title: Zoho CRM and WhatsApp Integration
seoTitle: Zoho CRM WhatsApp Integration: Chats and Automation
seoDescription: Send and receive WhatsApp messages from Zoho CRM, log chats against leads and automate follow-ups with approved templates. Options, costs and setup.
summary: A Zoho CRM–WhatsApp integration lets sales teams send and receive WhatsApp messages from inside Zoho CRM, logs every chat against the lead or contact, and triggers template messages automatically, such as a follow-up after a quote. Conversations stop living only on individual phones.

dataPoints.label: Options
dataPoints.value: Zoho's own WhatsApp integration, marketplace extensions, or a custom integration via the Cloud API

dataPoints.label: Message rules
dataPoints.value: Template messages to start conversations; free-form replies within the 24-hour window

dataPoints.label: Logged in CRM
dataPoints.value: Messages, delivery status and replies against the lead or contact

dataPoints.label: Typical automations
dataPoints.value: Welcome message on new lead, quote follow-up, meeting reminder, payment reminder

dataPoints.label: Pricing
dataPoints.value: Meta per-message charges plus any provider or extension fee

body:
## What to set up first

1. Capture WhatsApp enquiries as leads automatically.
2. A template for the first response within minutes.
3. Follow-up templates tied to deal stages.

## Keep it compliant

Record opt-in, respect opt-out requests and keep marketing messages separate from service messages.

See [automating sales follow-up with AI](/blog/automating-sales-follow-up-with-ai-without-sounding-like-a-robot).

faqs.q: Can several salespeople share one WhatsApp number?
faqs.a: Yes, through a shared inbox, with each chat assigned to an owner in the CRM.

faqs.q: Will old chats from personal phones move into the CRM?
faqs.a: Not automatically. The integration logs conversations from the business number going forward.
